purpose: Evidence and automation matrix for environmental and nearby-facility facts used in Moscow new-build search.

semantics.missing_value: unknown; absence from a source response is not zero, false, safe, clean, or confirmed absence
semantics.measured_noise: field-measured dB(A) observations are point-in-time and location-specific; do not aggregate them into a parcel or district score without a reviewed method and sampling model
semantics.proximity: road and airport distance are map-derived proximity proxies only; they are not acoustic measurements, flight-path exposure, or a noise score
semantics.air_quality: station pollutant readings remain station/time/pollutant observations; do not synthesize a district cleanliness rank from sparse stations
semantics.playground_absence: no matching mapped feature means none found in that source snapshot and coverage, not confirmed real-world absence
semantics.district_geometry: district assignment requires a pinned polygon dataset and version; mapped boundaries are not automatically legally authoritative
semantics.fact_container: record.facts maps stable criterion keys to typed facts with status, provenance, observed_at, and source_updated_at

fact_shape.value: typed scalar, array, object, or null
fact_shape.provenance: source ID, stable source record ID, source version/snapshot, source field, rights status, coverage status; derived facts also store method and input source IDs

semantics.coverage_rule: citywide or district aggregates require a complete, explicitly verified spatial/time coverage statement; otherwise return unknown or source-bounded observations

sources.name: Moscow Open Data portal API
sources.access: API version endpoint is public; dataset metadata and rows require api_key. No authorized key is available in this run; do not put credentials in files, command arguments, environment variables, or logs.
sources.evidence: 2026-10-09 probe: /version returned HTTP 200 and Version=1; /v1/datasets/2457 and /v1/datasets/2457/rows?$top=1 returned HTTP 401 with the portal response saying api_key is required. The official documentation SPA loaded but did not expose a static schema in the bounded check.

sources.name: Mobile ecology laboratory air results, dataset 2457
sources.access: Official 2024 report identifies this monthly open-data set and links dataset 2457. API metadata/rows require api_key; exact current row schema and reuse terms were not retrieved.
sources.evidence: Official report names the set as 'Данные передвижной лаборатории контроля загрязнения атмосферного воздуха', links data.mos.ru/opendata/2457, and says it updates monthly with measurement date, place, and visit results. This is survey evidence, not a complete district monitoring grid or district ranking.

sources.name: MosEcoMonitoring automatic air station network
sources.access: Official report says current station data are openly displayed on the MosEcoMonitoring site; a stable public machine endpoint, retention, schema, and reuse terms were not verified.
sources.evidence: Station observations are not equivalent to district-wide cleanliness ratings.

sources.name: Mobile ecology laboratory noise monitoring results
sources.access: Official 2024 report identifies monthly publication on Moscow Open Data with address, measurement date, and visit results. Current dataset ID/schema/terms were not verified; portal API requires api_key.
sources.evidence: Report describes location-specific mobile-lab observations associated with field inspections/complaints; not continuous coverage or a parcel acoustic score.

sources.name: Overture transportation segments
sources.access: Official bbox-downloadable GeoParquet; city data has not been fetched for this criteria task.
sources.evidence: Road segment geometry is a LineString; subtype=road and class includes motorway, trunk, primary, and other road classes. Distance depends on a pinned class policy and release.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap mapped playgrounds and aerodromes
sources.access: Public OSM PBF/Overpass is technically accessible; use a pinned bounded extract for scale. One small Overpass query is not a city-completeness check.
sources.evidence: Playgrounds are mapped with leisure=playground; aerodrome polygons/points may be mapped with aeroway=aerodrome. Preserve OSM object IDs, versions, timestamps, attribution and snapshot/query footprint.

sources.name: Overture divisions polygons (mapped district-boundary candidate)
sources.access: Official bbox-downloadable GeoParquet; this bounded run found source metadata with OSM relation IDs/versions. This is mapped geometry, not a substitute for legal validation.
sources.evidence: division_area supports Polygon/MultiPolygon and source/version provenance. Overture states sub-county coverage can be spotty; completeness for Moscow districts must be audited.

sources.name: Moscow district territorial division legal acts
sources.access: Official legal text and administration list. A current downloadable GIS layer of legally verified district polygons was not found in this audit.
sources.evidence: The 2024 official publication contains Law No. 14 amending Moscow Law No. 13-47 on city territorial division; it is not a ready-to-use polygon file.

criteria.evidence: Official sources found describe stations and field measurements, not a current, machine-readable cleanliness ranking for each Moscow district.
criteria.unknown_policy: unknown; never derive a district score from station readings, emissions, complaints, or historical AO composite rankings
criteria.coverage_note: verified current rating must cover every legal Moscow district and publish method/period; no such source is currently verified
criteria.refresh: recheck official Moscow datasets and their methodology before enabling

criteria.evidence: Retain pollutant, value, unit, station/place, timestamp, and source quality flags only when supplied by the source.
criteria.unknown_policy: unknown if endpoint, station, pollutant, unit, time, QA flag, or terms are missing; do not reinterpret as district cleanliness
criteria.coverage_note: station/source observations only; no inference for unobserved locations or districts
criteria.refresh: source-defined; record each observation timestamp and retrieval time

criteria.evidence: Source documentation establishes periodic mobile-laboratory noise monitoring; exact measurement field names and equivalent/maximum level semantics require current dataset metadata.
criteria.unknown_policy: unknown when no measured record matches; preserve observation time/place/source class and distinct equivalent/max metrics if documented; no inferred value
criteria.coverage_note: matched, source-documented measurement only; never interpret gaps as quiet
criteria.refresh: monthly source publication if confirmed; store retrieval and measurement times separately

criteria.evidence: Minimum planar-local distance to Overture road segment geometry whose class is exactly one of motorway, trunk, primary; the class set is a versioned product policy.
criteria.unknown_policy: unknown if source coverage or geometry is missing; report selected nearest segment ID/class/release; this is proximity only and must never be labeled dB, measured noise, or acoustic exposure
criteria.coverage_note: complete pinned segment coverage around the queried point is needed to call the nearest road; otherwise status is source_bounded/incomplete
criteria.refresh: on Overture release change or class-policy change

criteria.evidence: Minimum local projected distance to mapped aeroway=aerodrome point/area geometry; preserve whether input was a point or polygon and its OSM ID/version.
criteria.unknown_policy: unknown if no airport geometry is present in source coverage; this is not flight-path, aircraft-frequency, or acoustic exposure
criteria.coverage_note: complete pinned airport-geometry coverage for the requested region is needed to call the nearest airport; otherwise source_bounded/incomplete

criteria.label_ru: Игровые площадки на карте в радиусе 500 м
criteria.evidence: Count OSM leisure=playground geometries intersecting a 500m metric buffer; deduplicate stable OSM element type/id and retain versions.
criteria.unknown_policy: 0 means none found within the examined source snapshot/coverage only; expose coverage and snapshot; never call it confirmed real-world absence
criteria.coverage_note: bounded search coverage and snapshot must be attached; full city distribution summaries require complete pinned extract coverage

criteria.evidence: The pinned Overture/OSM extraction contains 130 unique district-name polygons; the official 2024 district-administration list is indexed to 133. Candidate polygon union covers 98.817697% of the selected OSM city-mask area, leaving 1.182303% uncovered by planar WGS84 area ratio. This does not validate legal names or coverage.
criteria.unknown_policy: unknown on gap, overlap, incomplete mapped set, ambiguous name, or unverified boundary update; mapped district result is not legal certification
criteria.coverage_note: complete current district polygon set with no unresolved gaps/overlaps and boundary-set hash; legal certainty separately unverified
criteria.refresh: on boundary dataset or applicable Moscow law revision

operational_boundaries: Do not convert road or airport proximity to an acoustic score or dB value.
Do not fabricate a current district cleanliness rating from station data or old composite AO ratings.
Do not treat OSM/Overture polygon coverage as an authoritative legal boundary without source validation.
Record source snapshot/release, query bbox, timestamp, license/attribution, stable source IDs, row counts and SHA-256 for every retained dataset.
Never issue repeated or unbounded public Overpass queries for Moscow-scale collection.
